name: euler2d_naca0012
title: NACA 0012, inviscid, Mach 0.8 and 0.5 at alpha 1.25 deg (2D Euler, C-domain, GCI)

reference.source: Vassberg and Jameson (2010), J. Aircraft 47(4), Table 11, p. 1165: mean of FLO82 0.356209, OVERFLOW 0.351663, CFL3D 0.348226
reference.shortfall: Study design, not the solver (found in Prompt 7b): halving only the WALL cell size refined the mesh very little (7,326 / 9,400 / 13,251 cells), because the far-field size (2 c) and the growth rate stayed fixed, so the shock region is barely refined; the GCI observed order of 10 shows the sequence is not a proper refinement, and the comparison falls back to the finest mesh (Cl 0.338, still rising: 0.311, 0.331, 0.338). The coarsest mesh also stopped at 40,000 iterations without converging. A systematic study (all sizes scaled together, up to about 100k cells) needs Prompt 8 speed; Cd (2.4 %) and the Mach 0.5 lift (2.9 %) are within their tolerances.

reference.source: Vassberg and Jameson (2010), J. Aircraft 47(4), Table 11, p. 1165: mean of FLO82 0.022685, OVERFLOW 0.022453, CFL3D 0.022501
Vassberg and Jameson (2010), J. Aircraft 47(4), Table 10, p. 1165: mean of FLO82 0.180346, OVERFLOW 0.179777, CFL3D 0.179784

study.title: Runs
notes: Reference (Vassberg & Jameson 2010, Table 11, p. 1165): Mach 0.8, alpha 1.25 deg: continuum Cl 0.3482 (CFL3D) to 0.3562 (FLO82), Cd 0.02245 to 0.02268; Table 10: Mach 0.5, alpha 1.25 deg: Cl 0.17978 to 0.18035, Cd -> 0 (FLO82 4.5e-8).
Cm here is about the quarter chord (template convention); the reference's Cm is about the quarter chord as well.
Mach 0.8, Cl: GCI observed order 10.01, extrapolated value 0.339457, GCI fine 0.537 %, GCI coarse 3.06 %, asymptotic ratio 1.020.
Mach 0.8, Cd: GCI observed order 8.68, extrapolated value 0.0220685, GCI fine 0.347 %, GCI coarse 1.56 %, asymptotic ratio 1.010.
Mach 0.5, Cl: GCI observed order 1.78, extrapolated value 0.181928, GCI fine 5.16 %, GCI coarse 5.3 %, asymptotic ratio 0.756 (oscillatory convergence).
Mach 0.5, Cd: GCI observed order 10.04, extrapolated value 0.000257395, GCI fine 15.4 %, GCI coarse 55.1 %, asymptotic ratio 0.638.
Mach 0.5 drag on the three meshes: 0.000966, 0.000460, 0.000294 (inviscid subcritical flow has zero drag; it must fall with refinement).
